purpose: Teach: マウンテン/ロハス/ベア/アルト/デュオ/ゴースト/オーソドックス/スピリット

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マウンテンバイク部入ったろ
lines.en: So you actually joined the mountain bike club, huh?
lines.style: Teasing but genuinely curious. Light, quick attack on the opening. Leans forward slightly. A small smirk — playful accusation, not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ロハスとか言い出したな、桜
lines.en: Oh, you're the one suddenly talking about living sustainably, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry deflection. Flat, cool delivery on the main clause. A beat of silence before the name — like he's turning it back on her. Slight edge, but underneath it: he noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ベア似のぬいぐるみ持ってるよな
lines.en: So you've got that bear plushie sitting on your bed, right?
lines.style: Casual accusation. Soft attack. Knowing tone — like she caught him in something small and harmless. Voice stays level, almost conversational, the teasing in the rhythm not the inflection.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、合唱でアルトパートだったろ、桜
lines.en: And you sang alto in the choir, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirrors her rhythm back at her. Curious underneath the turnabout. His voice steadies on her name — small counterattack but without heat. Genuine question buried under the deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭でデュオで歌ってたな
lines.en: You were the one doing that duet at the culture festival, though.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through. Softer than before. The accusation has lost its edge — this one isn't a deflection, it's actual observation. Voice opens up slightly on 'duet'.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゴーストもの映画ばっか観てたな、桜
lines.en: Weren't you the one only watching ghost movies for like three months straight, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, almost exasperated. But the tone stays warm underneath — he's cataloguing her quirks like they matter. Quick rhythm, slight trailing off after 'straight'. Name lands with a half-smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、オーソドックスな受験勉強してるな
lines.en: So you're actually doing straight-up exam prep, huh?
lines.style: Slight surprise. Curious, almost impressed tone. Slower pace than his other lines — he's actually checking if he heard this right. Opens with genuine observation, not deflection.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、部のチームスピリット語ってたな、桜
lines.en: And you're the one who was going on about team spirit and club unity, Sakura.
lines.style: Close, warm. Gentle landing. Not quite a smile but the shape of one in his voice. This one's not an accusation — it's almost tender. He's naming something he likes about her.
